I will test a simple mean on this same pool to see if equal weighting is robust or if the specific weights in a1 are critical. This tests the sensitivity of the winning strategy to the combination method within the best-performing model subset.

The current leader (a1) uses a weighted combination on a small, diverse pool (pool4). To challenge this with a different structural approach, I will test a median combination on the same pool (pool4). The median is robust to outliers and performs well when models have uncorrelated errors, which aligns with the moderate ranking stability and the presence of distinct error clusters in the forecast shape.
